method: LightGBM gradient-boosted trees, exported and run without LightGBM on the server
data: 170,506 stock-days of 63 NSE stocks (live), with India VIX, Brent and USD/INR from Yahoo Finance and weather alert days from Open-Meteo
definition: Sharp fall: a loss of 5% or more over the next 5 sessions. Downside: the 5-session return that only 5% of cases fall below.
